title: How to Choose Your Interior Design Style

body:
That moment when you're standing in a shop (or staring at your cart) thinking: 
'Do I actually like this, or am I just guessing?' — I hear it constantly.
❤️

The truth is, most people start buying pieces they like before they've worked out what they're actually going for.


Which is how you may end up with pieces you individually love but that never quite click together. 
 I wrote a guide that walks you through how to spot your own style before you spend a penny — so that when you do choose wall art, it feels right straight away rather than 'maybe'.

primaryButton.label: READ THE GUIDE & FIND YOUR STYLE

close: Once you know your style, wall art is honestly the easiest — and lowest-risk — place to bring it to life first.
What's making you hesitate most right now — colour, size, or just not knowing where to begin?
Hit reply — I read every one.
